text:
deploy-bot: predeploy prompt-eval gate triggered for release rwd-v2.8.0-canary. 5/6 checks passed, 1 failed: conversation_clarity (regression 4.2%). Report: https://intranet/reports/1812345678 :rotating_light:

laura-release: @emily-qa can you confirm whether this is a noisy failure or a real regression? We have a promotion window in 4 hours.

emily-qa: digging in now. quick summary: failing only on `prompt-regressions-v2` eval set, mostly short transactional prompts. Not seen in smoke tests. Sample failing metrics:
```
metric: conversation_clarity
baseline: 0.820
candidate: 0.785
delta: -0.035 (-4.27%)
examples failing:
  - "When will my invoice be generated?" -> candidate truncated, baseline ok
  - "Summarize migration steps" -> candidate omitted step 2
```

aj-eng: any recent model infra changes? quant bits, tokenizer, sampling?

emily-qa: model build included a quant tweak: `qparams=perchannel_rms_8bit` and a small tokeniser update (whitespace normalization). I re-ran eval with previous tokenizer + new quant and still see drop.

carla-product: user-impact note: these prompts are common in billing & onboarding flows for EU customers. Even a small drop makes support load spike.

rick-eng: suggestion: keep the canary running but block promotion. We can pin production hosts to rwd-2.7.9 while we triage. Commands: 
```
redwood pin model rwd-2.7.9 --scope=production --reason="prompt-eval regression"
redwood set-route --model rwd-v2.8.0-canary --weight=0 --scope=promotion
```

laura-release: +1 to pin and hold promotion. @aj-eng and @emily-qa please own root cause. Can someone open a tracking ticket and link to this thread?

emily-qa: creating ticket INC-2026-45 now, linking eval reports and failing examples. ETA preliminary triage 90m.

ops-bot: action: model pin requested by laura-release. Pin job started (job id pj-4482). Will post status. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: promotion blocked by eval-gate: reason "conversation_clarity regression". Promotion state: ON_HOLD.

aj-eng: quick hypothesis — quantization path might be dropping subtle tokens in short utterances. I'll run a focused diff on logits for failing prompts (`./logit-diff --base rwd-2.7.9 --cand rwd-2.8.0`). Will post results in 30-45m.

carla-product: thanks. if fix is >4h, we should schedule a hotfix release and communicate to support.

laura-release: decision: HOLD promotion. Pin confirmed once ops-bot finishes. Notify support and update release notes with gated reason. We'll reconvene after triage. :eyes:
